title: Pasulka finds space program records classified when she starts her study

tellings.quote: I began my study in 2012 do the normal academic search for the Space Program information immediately see how much is classified

plain: When she began her research in 2012, Diana Pasulka, an academic who studies religion and belief in UFOs, says she did the usual scholarly search for records on the space programme and saw right away how much of it was classified. She tells this from her own experience. She raises it because it suggests that much of what she set out to study was kept out of public view from the start.
